info.name: Server Rules Service - Local lab
info.description: Run the entire collection in order against the local lab implementation. Creates three rule versions per run; no cleanup endpoint exists. Captures generated versions automatically; never assumes version 1. Uses public mock tokens, not real JWTs. Tests config/rules.php provisional policy. Requires the Server Rules endpoint feature branch. Change rulesBaseUrl if the service port changes. Do not define environment variables matching generated collection IDs. Negative tests are expected to pass on the specified error status. No Docker/PostgreSQL or shared-stack integration is claimed.
